text:
Priya (Sales): Hey team — OrthoAlign legal/ciso pushed POC to next step but need compliance artifacts asap. Ask: SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF, ISO 27001 scope excerpt, pen-test letter (signed if possible), network diagram showing VPC peering and private endpoints, and a brief note on KMS/HSM usage. Also they asked whether Dedicated pricing changes for single-tenant isolation + 180d logs + on-prem connector. Can someone own the evidence bundle?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can take the network diagram and write a short tech summary for the KMS/HSM (we use customer CMKs via KMS integrations for private deployments). Quick Q: do they need full ISO cert or just scope/controls excerpt?
Noah (Security): We can provide SOC2 attestation PDF and ISO scope excerpt. For pen-test: we have a third-party pen-test attestation showing last test date and summary, unsigned. If they require a signed letter on company letterhead, Legal + CISO approval needed — that'll take a few days.
Tara (Legal): FYI we usually only sign bespoke pentest letters for enterprise contracts. We can offer a template attestation with a Legal-approved signature if the deal size warrants it. Please flag to Sales if signed attestation is a gating item.
Lena (Finance): Pricing note: single-tenant isolation + 180d logs + on-prem connector is non-trivial. Rough uplift: +18-25% depending on required network egress and reserved GPU footprint. Also, guaranteed POC throughput (burst) may require a short-term reserved commit — that'll change monthly pricing. I'll give a banded estimate if you want.
Omar (Customer Success): I'll pull SOC2_Package_2024.pdf and ISO27001_scope_excerpt.pdf from our proofpack bucket. Preferred delivery: presigned s3 + short nav README, unless they ask for a secure dataroom.
Casey (Docs): I can assemble a 1-page Evidence Index and a one-paragraph FAQ on what each artifact proves and who to contact. I can also include a redaction note for any IP-sensitive paths.
Priya (Sales): Timeline: customer asked for artifacts by Tuesday COB. Realistic? If not, we'll request extension. Also calling out: they want to know if signed pentest letter is mandatory for their procurement — I'll check and report back.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Timeline: we can get SOC2 + ISO excerpt + network diagram + KMS note by Tuesday if Mike/Omar upload SOC2 now. Signed pentest will likely miss Tuesday unless Legal expedites.
Noah (Security): Uploading pen-test_attestation_unsigned.pdf to s3://presigned.orthoalign/poc_evidence/ now. It includes vuln summary and remediation status. If they ask for fresh pentest, estimate ~4-6 weeks.
Omar (Customer Success): SOC2 and ISO uploads complete: s3://presigned.orthoalign/poc_evidence/SOC2_Attestation_2024.pdf and s3://presigned.orthoalign/poc_evidence/ISO27001_Scope.pdf. README.txt added with redaction note.
Lena (Finance): From a pricing perspective tell them: preliminary uplift estimate +20% for single-tenant + 180d logs; on-prem connector add-on quoted separately. If they want reserved capacity for demo, that's extra. I'll follow up with a 3-option pricing sheet by EOD tomorrow.
Tara (Legal): I've reviewed the pen-test template. If Sales confirms signed letter is required, I need the procurement contact and intended signatory to proceed. Also: any NDA changes?
Casey (Docs): Evidence Index and access README ready and uploaded to the same presigned folder. Will include contact list: Priya (sales), Ravi (tech), Noah (security), Tara (legal).
Priya (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll tell OrthoAlign we can deliver the attestation PDFs, ISO excerpt, network diagram, KMS summary, and Evidence Index by Tuesday COB. I'll call out that a signed pentest letter is possible but will require Legal and may delay. Also sharing the preliminary +20% uplift on Dedicated. Closing loop once customer confirms whether signed pentest is mandatory. :thumbsup:
